about: Sterling Wire & Cable operates from Minneapolis, Minnesota, where it serves as a wire and cable specialist. The company stocks over 15,000 wire and cable products, including categories such as data and communications cable, building wire, hook-up and lead wire, broadcast and AV cable, electronic cable, fire alarm cable, and safety, sound, and security cable. It also offers value-added services: custom cable design, dyeing and striping (28–10 AWG, 1–2 day lead time), custom respooling and coiling, cut-and-strip services, cut-and-labeled tubing, twisting (28–12 AWG, 1–2 week lead time), consolidated shipments, same-day shipping for orders placed before noon, vendor-managed inventory programs, UL/CSA repackaging, and full traceability to the original manufacturer. Sterling serves industries that require specialized cabling, such as access control systems (evidenced by 3M-approved and Solventum-approved cables), data communications, building infrastructure, broadcast and AV, electronics, fire alarm, and security. Its customers include original equipment manufacturers, contractors, and integrators who need both standard and custom cable solutions. The company emphasizes on-time delivery, competitive pricing, and collaborative innovation to create reliable solutions. Differentiators highlighted by Sterling include same-day shipping on stock items, vendor-managed inventory programs, UL and CSA certification for repackaging, and full product traceability.
